prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens (wait_info) was helpful (+8.9% measured, p=0.000775), slightly exceeding the predicted +8.0%.
Redesigning the pet customization stage (redesign) showed no clear effect (+3.7%, p=0.295), falling far short of the +12.0% prediction.
Deferring sign-in after pet selection (reorder/sign_in) showed no clear effect (+0.3%, p=0.907), far below the +10.0% prediction.
Predictions for redesigns and step reordering were significantly too optimistic.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +8.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Display & Launch Status Indicator: Add clear status indicators and desktop launch instructions on the waiting screen to explain how and where the pet will appear. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop, and the home waiting stage has long wait times (mean 2336s).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen: Insert a desktop controls quick reference screen before home_intro explaining how to drag, right-click, hide, and summon the pet. (why: 3 support tickets explicitly noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Fast Track Path Choice Guidance: Display an explanatory hint comparing instant preset pets versus custom pet upload to reduce decision paralysis. (why: choose_path drop-off is 23.8% with an exceptionally long mean duration (514s).)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Quality Guidance Flow: Add photo selection guidelines and tip carousel directly on the photo upload screen to prevent generation errors. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failure or distorted output, and adoption conversion is low (60.9%).)
4: [sign_in, copy] Explicit Account Pet Sync Copy: Update the sign-in headline and action button copy to explicitly state that signing in saves pet progress. (why: sign_in drops 27.1% of users, and support receives high volume regarding missing pets after re-login.)
5: [adoption, layout] Grid View Pet Companion Browse Layout: Change pick_friend screen layout to a structured grid layout for faster comparison of preset companions. (why: Adoption stage takes a median 89s and mean 1017s, indicating visual navigation drag.)
6: [home, notification] Background Desktop Notification When Pet Ready: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet creation finishes. (why: Mean waiting time on home stage is 2336s (~38 min), causing users to switch away and abandon.)

scores.note: Wait screen info changes have proven successful (+8.9%); strong support and funnel evidence.
High drop-off at finish and clear support complaints, but adding a new screen requires release and has moderate confidence.
Cheap text/hint change for a step with 23.8% drop-off and high duration, though no explicit support tickets.
Adoption has high drop-off and clear support issues, but new flow/carousel has higher cost and modest confidence.
High volume support issues and 27.1% sign_in drop-off; copy changes are cheap and low-risk.
Layout redesigns in adoption previously yielded insignificant results (+3.7%, p=0.295).
Addresses extreme mean wait times on home screen with notifications, building on proven wait-stage patterns.
